def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # The sparse non-background input color marks line endpoints; connect collinear marks.
    marker=next(v for v,n in counts.most_common() if v != bg)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        cs=[c for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==marker]
        if len(cs)>=2:
            for c in range(min(cs)+1,max(cs)):
                if grid[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=3
    for c in range(w):
        rs=[r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c]==marker]
        if len(rs)>=2:
            for r in range(min(rs)+1,max(rs)):
                if grid[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=3
    return out
PY
